description: Warm check-in prompts for seniors in Singapore (bilingual zh/en).

questions.zh: 早安，今天身体还舒坦吗？
questions.en: Good morning—how are you feeling in yourself today?

questions.zh: 今天有没有喝够水、吃顿暖胃的早餐呀？
questions.en: Have you had enough water and a comforting breakfast today?

questions.zh: 最近天气热，出门有没有带伞、小心中暑哦。
questions.en: It’s been warm—did you bring an umbrella or stay cool when you went out?

questions.zh: 今天有去巴刹或熟食中心逛逛吗？看到什么喜欢的菜？
questions.en: Did you pop by the market or hawker centre—see anything tasty?

questions.zh: 昨晚睡得好吗？半夜有没有醒过来？
questions.en: How was sleep—any wake-ups in the night?

questions.zh: 午饭有没有吃饱？会不会太油或太咸？
questions.en: Did lunch fill you up—was anything too oily or salty?

questions.zh: 下午有没有小歇一会儿，听听歌或看看电视？
questions.en: Did you rest a bit this afternoon—maybe some music or TV?

questions.zh: 今天家人或朋友有打电话来聊天吗？
questions.en: Did family or a friend ring for a chat today?

questions.zh: 晚上准备吃什么？有没有想吃的家常菜？
questions.en: What are you thinking for dinner—any home-style dish you fancy?

questions.zh: 今天心情怎么样？有没有什么想跟人分享的小事？
questions.en: How’s your mood—anything small you’d like to share?

questions.zh: 楼下的邻里或保安大哥今天有没有跟你打招呼？
questions.en: Did a neighbour or the friendly guard downstairs say hello today?

questions.zh: 坐巴士或地铁出门还顺利吗？有没有位子坐？
questions.en: Was the bus or MRT ride alright—did you get a seat?

questions.zh: 公园里有没有看到你常去坐坐的那张凳子？
questions.en: Did you see your usual bench at the park?

questions.zh: 今天有没有吃一点水果，比如香蕉、苹果或木瓜？
questions.en: Any fruit today—banana, apple, or papaya maybe?

questions.zh: 最近追的连续剧或新闻，有什么印象深的？
questions.en: Anything from your shows or the news that stuck with you?

questions.zh: 家里窗门通风还好吗？空气清不清新？
questions.en: Is the home airing well—does the air feel fresh?

questions.zh: 有没有记得按时吃医生开的药？需要我陪你念一次药名吗？
questions.en: Have medicines been on time today? (I’m only asking—no changes without your doctor.)

questions.zh: 今天有没有哪里酸酸的、紧紧的，想轻轻活动一下？
questions.en: Any stiff or tight spots—a little gentle movement might feel nice.

questions.zh: 想喝一杯温温的茶还是薏米水？
questions.en: Fancy a warm tea or barley water?

questions.zh: 傍晚有没有看到晚霞或凉一点的风？
questions.en: Did you catch a cooler breeze or a bit of sunset?

questions.zh: 有没有想跟好久没见的朋友发条信息？
questions.en: Anyone you’d like to text—you haven’t caught up in a while?

questions.zh: 今天有没有笑一笑？哪怕是一件小事也好。
questions.en: Did something make you smile today, even a little thing?

questions.zh: 周末有没有打算去哪个熟悉的地方走走？
questions.en: Any familiar place you might visit on the weekend?

questions.zh: 电视或收音机里，有没有听到喜欢的老歌？
questions.en: Hear any favourite songs on TV or the radio?

questions.zh: 晚上睡觉空调或风扇会不会太冷？被子够暖吗？
questions.en: Is the fan or AC too cool at night—are the blankets enough?
